urpx-shacl:AccountServiceAgreementShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "AccountServiceAgreement Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:AccountServiceAgreement ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:contractEffectiveDate ;
        sh:datatype xsd:dateTime ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:contractExpirationDate ;
        sh:datatype xsd:dateTime ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] .

urpx-shacl:AlternativeDimensionShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "AlternativeDimension Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:AlternativeDimension ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:dimensionDisplayName ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:dimensionProperty ;
        sh:datatype xsd:anyURI ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:customDimensionProperty ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:hasPossibleValues ;
        sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:path rdf:first ; sh:minCount 1 ] ] ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:referencesMetricInput ;
        sh:class urpx:MetricInput ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
    ] ;
    sh:xone (
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:dimensionProperty ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:customDimensionProperty ;
                sh:maxCount 0 ;
            ]
        ]
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:customDimensionProperty ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:dimensionProperty ;
                sh:maxCount 0 ;
            ]
        ]
    ) .

urpx-shacl:BooleanOperationNodeShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "BooleanOperationNode Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:BooleanOperationNode ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:operator ;
        sh:node urpx-shacl:BooleanOperatorValueShape ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:logicExpression ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:operandNodes ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:ComparisonNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:BooleanOperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:xone (
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operator ;
                sh:hasValue urpx:andOperator ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operandNodes ;
                sh:minCount 2 ;
            ]
        ]
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operator ;
                sh:hasValue urpx:orOperator ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operandNodes ;
                sh:minCount 2 ;
            ]
        ]
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operator ;
                sh:hasValue urpx:notOperator ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:operandNodes ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ]
        ]
    ) .

urpx-shacl:ConditionExpressionShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "ConditionExpression Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:ConditionExpression ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:rootNode ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:ComparisonNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:BooleanOperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] .

urpx-shacl:ComparisonNodeShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "ComparisonNode Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:ComparisonNode ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:description ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:logicExpression ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:name ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:operator ;
        sh:node urpx-shacl:OperatorValueShape ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:leftOperand ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:DatatypeOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:ObjectOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:CustomOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:OperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:rightOperand ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:DatatypeOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:ObjectOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:CustomOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:OperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] .

urpx-shacl:OperationNodeShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "OperationNode Shape"@en ;
    sh:targetClass urpx:OperationNode ;
    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:leftOperand ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:DatatypeOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:ObjectOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:CustomOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:OperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:operator ;
        sh:node urpx-shacl:OperatorValueShape ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:rightOperand ;
        sh:or (
            [ sh:class urpx:DatatypeOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:ObjectOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:CustomOperandNode ]
            [ sh:class urpx:OperationNode ]
        ) ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] .

urpx-shacl:ObjectOperandNodeShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    rdfs:label "ObjectOperandNode Shape"@en ;

    sh:closed true ;
    sh:ignoredProperties ( rdf:type ) ;
    sh:property [

        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:referencesMetricInput ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path urpx:referencesValue ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:minCount 0 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:xone (
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:conditionProperty ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ]
        ]
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:referencesValue ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ]
        ]
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path urpx:referencesMetricInput ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:maxCount 1 ;
            ]
        ]
    ) .
